premise: In the long night Astronaut misses her grandmother; the satellite brings her grandmother's lullaby all the way from Earth, and she falls asleep as the station glides over.
inspiration: Andersen's 'The Nightingale' (the real song, not the mechanical one), turned: the real song travels all the way from home.

en-US.title: The Lullaby from Home
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} [softly] Far from home, in the long Moon night, {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face sad} Astronaut couldn't stop thinking of her grandmother. {satellite:enter} High above, the satellite caught {satellite:live hold} a message, sent all the way from Earth. It was a song: her grandmother's song, the one she sang at bedtime long ago. {astronaut:face surprised} [whispers] Listen… [sings] Hush now, little star, the night is wide… {astronaut:face happy} Astronaut hummed along. {canvas:satellites 14s} Tiny lights drifted across the sky. {station:enter} The space station glided over, {station:live} turning its wings, as if it were listening too. {astronaut:live} Astronaut tossed a pebble up and watched it float, slow as a lullaby. {satellite:glow} {astronaut:face sleeping} [softly] By the last line she was fast asleep, {all:face sleeping} and home didn't feel so far away.

es-ES.title: La nana de casa
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} [softly] Lejos de casa, en la larga noche lunar, {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face sad} Astronauta no dejaba de pensar en su abuela. {satellite:enter} Allá arriba, el satélite recogió {satellite:live hold} un mensaje enviado desde la Tierra. Era una canción: la canción de su abuela, la que le cantaba al dormir cuando era pequeña. {astronaut:face surprised} [whispers] Escucha… [sings] Duérmete, estrellita, que la noche es grande… {astronaut:face happy} Astronauta la tarareó. {canvas:satellites 14s} Unas lucecitas cruzaron el cielo. {station:enter} La estación espacial pasó deslizándose, {station:live} girando sus alas, como si también escuchara. {astronaut:live} Astronauta lanzó un guijarro al aire y lo vio flotar, lento como una nana. {satellite:glow} {astronaut:face sleeping} [softly] Al terminar la canción ya estaba dormida, {all:face sleeping} y su casa ya no parecía tan lejos.
